Server.Name: VIKINGSMOD
Server.Description:
For 7D2D Version 3.1 Stable Changelogs on Discord! What exactly is the VIKINGS MOD? The Vikings Mod is a massive overhaul for 7 Days to Die.
You awaken after a devastating accident in the year 845 – weak, disoriented, and clinging to life. (Check the buff in‑game at the bottom left!) The bodies of your friends are scattered everywhere. From this moment on, survival becomes your only purpose. You must learn to endure the brutal world of the Viking Age, adapt to ancient traditions, and fight beneath the watchful eyes of the gods.
At the beginning, you can only see the trader on the map until you unlock your compass. Press Y in‑game to open the FAME and HONOR window, and stride with unwavering resolve through the first steps.
The goal of the Vikings Mod is carved in fate: Become strong enough to face the three primordial bosses – SKARLUGR, LOKI, and FENRIR. Only when you have defeated them will you be welcomed into the circle of the gods and gain access to the mightiest weapons ever forged. May fortune stand at your side – for this world holds far more secrets than any warrior could uncover in a single lifetime.
IMPORTANT INFORMATION -Not compatible with any other mods The Vikings Mod is a full overhaul and must be played without additional mods.
-Mod translation available in EN and DE only No other languages are supported at this time.
-Disable subtitles Subtitles should be turned off for the intended experience.
-Dynamic Music: OFF Please disable dynamic music in the audio settings.
-UI Transparency Settings Background: 95% Foreground: 100%
Disable Occlusion in your graphics settings to prevent invisible blocks. A restart is required after updating.
